description: Add a sourdough starter to the baker's Loafy account: its name, the day it was started, notes and its story. Returns it with its id and a link, where photos are added. A name the baker already uses is not added again; that starter comes back, and update_starter changes it. Needs the baker's Loafy account.

birthday.description: The day the starter was started, as YYYY-MM-DD; today if left out.

notes.description: Notes on the starter, e.g. its flour and how it is fed.

story.description: Where the starter comes from, in the baker's words.

name: add_starter

input.description: The arguments as the tool used them, after any correction.

note.description: A remark on the whole result, such as why nothing was found.

notes.description: What was corrected or left out, such as a value outside its range.

saved.description: What was saved, in one sentence.

bakes.description: How many bakes it went into.

birthday.description: The day it was started, YYYY-MM-DD.

id.description: The starter's id, which update_starter takes.

url.description: The same answer, recipe or entry on loafy.ai.

title: Add a starter to Loafy
